prompt:

Find where git's user.name and user.email are declared in the home-manager config (grep home/ for the git program config) and give jujutsu the same identity via its home-manager module (programs.jujutsu.settings — user.name and user.email). Do not change git's config. If jujutsu is not currently installed via home-manager, wire the program properly rather than just writing a config file.

Verify: nix build .#nixosConfigurations.classic-laddie.config.system.build.toplevel --no-link in the FOREGROUND — open the PR first with "verification in progress", then comment the pasted result. Normal PR flow; terse comments; no Co-Authored-By trailers naming Claude or Anthropic; no AI mentions.
